name: TFM2 Patch Balance Improvement
summary: Keeps the r14 action/skill restore and blocks the optional native rebalancer from being enabled for normal play because it can desync patch-note UI from actual values.
notes: The optional native patch rebalancer is now treated as research-only and enable is blocked by default.
Reason: it can change real champion stat/growth values after the in-game patch-note article has already been generated.
Use the default EXE/bundle patch path for normal play; it keeps patch-note UI and actual values aligned.
